title: Lower Power: Squat
warmup: 2 rounds: 1:00 bike or 200m jog · 10 leg swings / side · 10 walking lunges · 3 × 10-yd A-skips
jumps: Back squat 3 → Box jump 5 → Light DB squat jump 5 → Fast pogos 10
Squat @ RPE 8 · DBs 10–20% bodyweight · Rest 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
Low hurdles, quick off the floor
strength: Lower as slowly as you can · band assist OK

cond.subtitle: All-out sprints, full recovery
items: Every round as hard as the first
cond.scaling: Bike taken? Treadmill sprints or 20-yd shuttle sprints

note: Power is about speed. If your bar or your jumps slow down, end the set.
